messages:
Monica (People Ops): quick question re: sales comp folks and after-tax elective deferrals + in-plan Roth conversions. Someone on commission wants to do in-plan conversion of after-tax deferrals. any gotchas?
Ben (People Ops): they can elect after-tax if our plan doc permits, but conversions depend on TPA processing rules. we need to confirm if in-service conversions allow variable comp sources.
Jordan (FinOps): payroll side: commission pay is coded differently each pay. we need to ensure the after-tax deduction code maps reliably so the vendor can identify conversion-eligible buckets. also watch annual contribution aggregation for limit checks.
Alex (Sales): how does this affect bonus/commission timing? i get monthly draws + quarterlies. if i opt after-tax, will the conversion hit immediately?
Ben (People Ops): depends on vendor batch cadence. some TPAs run conversions monthly, others quarterly. if a conversion runs and the after-tax contribution from a bonus isn't yet posted, it won't be included until next run.
Payroll Bot: created ticket PR-8342 to add payroll deduction code ATX and conversion flag ATX_CONV. assigned to Payroll Ops.
Monica (People Ops): do we need a separate enrollment form for variable comp earners, or can they just select "After-tax voluntary" in Workday?
Ben (People Ops): Workday election is fine. add note in the enrollment guide: "For commission/bonus, after-tax deferrals are applied per paycheck; conversions run on vendor schedule; verify with TPA for terminations."
TPA Admin: confirming: our platform supports in-plan conversions for after-tax balances and will tag by payroll code. we need the `ATX_CONV` flag to trigger automatic conversions. conversions for terminated employees are processed only on request by plan admin unless plan doc mandates automatic processing.
Jordan (FinOps): another consideration: in-plan conversions don't change ADP/ACP testing inputs for the year; the contributions still count toward testing. conversions only move money between subaccounts. if lots of high-earner after-tax contributions occur, could pressure testing.
Alex (Sales): and tax reporting? are converted amounts hit as Roth basis right away?
Ben (People Ops): conversions move after-tax basis to Roth subaccount; earnings on those after-tax amounts (pre-conversion) remain pre-tax until distributed. advise reps to talk to a tax advisor.
Monica (People Ops): action items: 1) Payroll to add `ATX` and `ATX_CONV` codes (PR-8342). 2) Ben to request TPA sample schedule & confirm in-service rules. 3) Jordan to run a pro-forma ADP/ACP test with hypothetical high after-tax volumes. can we commit to updates by EOD?
Ben (People Ops): will ping TPA and post result in #benefits by 2pm.
Jordan (FinOps): i can run pro-forma this afternoon if payroll gives sample volumes.
Payroll Bot: PR-8342 updated: payroll code ATX staged in sandbox, awaiting payroll ops deploy.
Monica (People Ops): great, thanks everyone. i'll draft a short FAQ blurb and include the caveats (vendor cadence, testing, termination handling). :thumbsup:
